Hikari · The Art of Sushi, Perfected

The original prompt, shown as plain text. Select the text to copy it.

Prompt

Create an elegant, immersive homepage for a Japanese sushi restaurant called "Hikari" (meaning "light") located in a modern urban setting. The design should balance Japanese minimalism with warmth and sophistication, evoking the precision of sushi craft and the calm of a traditional dining experience.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Hikari" in both English (clean sans-serif, Noto Sans) and Japanese characters "光" beside it in a brush-stroke style
- Links: Menu, Omakase, Our Story, Gallery, Reservations
- Right side: "Reserve a Table" button — solid #B91C1C (deep red), white text, 8px border-radius
- Background: transparent on hero, transitions to #0F172A (dark navy) on scroll
- Text color: white on hero, stays white on dark background
- Mobile: minimal hamburger icon, slide-down panel with centered links

- Centered overlay content with text-shadow for legibility:

  - Headline: "The Art of Sushi, Perfected"
  - Subheadline: "A 14-seat omakase experience featuring the freshest fish flown in daily from Tokyo's Toyosu Market."
  - Two CTAs: "View Omakase Menu" (solid #B91C1C) and "Make a Reservation" (outlined white, 1px border)
- Subtle slow zoom animation on the background image (Ken Burns effect, 20s cycle)
- Bottom: thin decorative line with a small circle in the center (Japanese-inspired divider)

Each piece of nigiri is shaped by hand, seasoned with decades of tradition, and served at the precise moment it reaches perfection. Our fish arrives daily from Toyosu Market, and our rice is seasoned with a house-blend vinegar aged for three years."

Design: Japanese-inspired minimalism meets modern sophistication. Primary: #B91C1C (deep red/aka), accent: #F59E0B (gold/kin), dark background: #0F172A (navy), warm sections: #FFFBEB (cream), card surfaces: #1E293B. Typography: Noto Sans for headings and body (clean, supports Japanese characters), weight 400/600/700. A decorative brush-script font for Japanese accent text. Generous negative space — 96px section padding, 40px element spacing. Thin gold dividers between sections. Subtle animations: fade-in on scroll, smooth hover transitions (300ms ease).

Responsive: On mobile, hero text stays centered with smaller font size. Seasonal menu cards stack vertically. Omakase section stacks (photos on top, content below). Gallery switches to 2-column grid. Reviews become swipeable cards. Reservation form stacks below details at full width. Footer columns stack with centered alignment. Minimum touch targets: 44px. Navigation becomes hamburger with slide-down overlay.
